buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Carle gets a slim nod on freshness. Carle has 73 games on the legs over 14 days (3 matches) against 120 for De Reales (6). In the past week De Reales has played 4 matches, Carle 2.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on motivation and pressure. De Reales is on the way up (+108 Elo over 90 days) while Carle has been sliding (-27). When it goes the distance, De Reales has won 75% of deciding sets over the past year to Carle's 50%. Offsetting that, Carle is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on conditions. On Clay, De Reales has won 66% over the past year (38 matches) to Carle's 52% (27). De Reales has 21 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Carle only 13, so the adjustment period is shorter. Offsetting that, both rate above their overall level on Clay, Carle by more (+35 Elo against +16 for De Reales).
